g.text: PROJECT 100 / DESCRIPTIVE VECTOR RECORD / 5 OCTOBER 2026
V6 PUMP
DEPLOYMENT
Evening training only (State C); replaces V1
BASE
500–600 mL cold filtered water
INGREDIENTS
ALLMAX Impact PUMP Xtreme (Blue Raspberry): 2 scoops / 31 g; ALLMAX MuscleEAA Xtreme
(Cherry Limeade): 1 scoop / 17.73 g; Compound Solutions / ALLMAX PeakO2: 2,000 mg by
mass; ALLMAX Essentials Betaine Anhydrous (TMG): 2,500 mg; ALLMAX Essentials
Citrulline Malate 2:1: 4–6 g; ALLMAX Essentials Pure Taurine Powder: 2–3 g; AOR
Xerenoos Citicoline: 1 capsule / 250 mg, swallowed separately with water
PROTOCOL
Evening training override; 20–30 minutes before the evening session. Citicoline is a
separate capsule at T−30 minutes. Never combined with V1 on the same calendar day.
RECORDED BRANCH
State C: evening training override, documented 5 October 2026.
EXCLUSION
V1 and V6 are never used on the same calendar day. Both are inactive on rest days.
SHAKER EXCLUSIONS
No added salt or creatine HCl; the source records a stimulant-free PUMP base.
COMPANION ROUTING
V2 remains intra-session; V4 moves after the evening workout; V5 is inactive; V10
remains the night anchor.
SOURCE LIMIT
This reproduces the supplied formulation and branch rules. Ingredient effects,
product-label subcomponents and safety guarantees are not independently established
here.
Personal system record; not a safety guarantee or prescription.
